claims.text: Park Hyatt Kyoto sits along the cobblestones of Ninenzaka in Higashiyama.

findings.quote: Nestled along the storied cobblestones of Ninenzaka in Higashiyama, Park Hyatt Kyoto is a luxury guesthouse

claims.text: The hotel is located within Kyoto's largest preserved traditional building district.

findings.quote: Laying claim to a landmark location within Kyoto's largest preserved traditional building district

claims.text: The hotel is stacked on a hill with a maze of hallways, corridors and garden paths.

findings.quote: stacked on a hill with a maze of hallways and corridors and garden paths that you cannot see until you're in them

claims.text: The rooms feature interiors crafted from fragrant tamo wood and contemporary art by local artists.

findings.quote: including the interior crafted from fragrant tamo wood, contemporary art created by local artists, and the Japanese gardens on display throughout the property

claims.text: Guest rooms offer a working area and a day bed.

findings.quote: Offering one king bed, a working area and a day bed that provides space for greater relaxation

claims.text: Kyoyamato is a ryotei with a history dating back to 1877.

findings.quote: Kyoyamato is a prestigious ryotei with a history dating back to 1877.

claims.text: Yasaka is the hotel's signature teppanyaki restaurant, combining Japanese tradition with French techniques.

findings.quote: “Yasaka,” Park Hyatt Kyoto’s signature restaurant, offers a teppanyaki experience where culinary theater meets French elegance.
Honoring Japanese tradition while infused with French techniques, it highlights premium ingredients and Kyoto’s seasonality.

claims.text: Kohaku bar creations highlight Japanese whiskey, sake and gin with seasonal ingredients.

findings.quote: Kohaku offers an intimate bar experience where ritual and craft meet cocktails.
creations highlight Japanese whiskey, sake, and gin with seasonal ingredients.

claims.text: The Living Room offers a five-course afternoon tea by day and becomes a wine and sake bar by night.

findings.quote: By day, it offers a Signature Five-Course Afternoon Tea with refined pairings and sometimes live Koto performance. By night, it becomes a Wine & Sake Bar with curated wines, sake, and artisanal pairings.

claims.text: In-room dining includes a Japanese breakfast prepared by Sanso Kyoyamato.

findings.quote: Room service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and includes Western breakfast, Japanese breakfast prepared by Sanso Kyoyamato

claims.text: World of Hyatt Globalist members and suite guests can enjoy champagne at The Living Room daily.

findings.quote: World of Hyatt Globalist members as well as guests staying in one of the hotel’s nine suites can enjoy free-flowing Champagne in The Living Room on the 1st floor daily from 5–6 p.m.

claims.text: The Spa and Fitness is available exclusively to hotel guests.

findings.quote: The Spa and Fitness at Park Hyatt Kyoto is a tranquil oasis that is available for use exclusively by hotel guests.

claims.text: The hotel was built as a partnership of the Pritzker, Takenaka and Kyoyamato families, with Tony Chi as interior designer.

findings.quote: The structure is a partnership of the Pritzker, Takenaka (a 17th-generation construction family responsible for many of Japan's temples), and Kyoyamato families, with Tony Chi as interior designer.

claims.text: Kyoyamato is set within a group of heritage buildings designated as cultural assets by Kyoto City.

findings.quote: Set within a group of heritage buildings designated as cultural assets by Kyoto City

claims.text: The hotel is set on historic temple grounds with views of Yasaka Pagoda and the machiya townscape.

findings.quote: Set on historic temple grounds, the hotel offers sweeping views of Yasaka Pagoda and the timeless machiya townscape

claims.text: Guests can take an exclusive tour of Kiyomizu-dera Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Kyoto guests can enjoy an exclusive tour of Kiyomizu-dera Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site

claims.text: Some rooms have a tsuboniwa, a private Japanese garden.

findings.quote: An exclusive tsuboniwa, or private Japanese garden, gives a layer of serenity and calm.

claims.text: Children under 10 are asked not to attend dinner service at Yasaka.

findings.quote: we kindly request that children under the age of 10 not attend dinner service.

claims.text: Access to Kohaku bar is restricted to guests aged 20 and above.

findings.quote: Access to Kohaku is restricted by law to guests aged 20 and above.

claims.text: Kyoyamato operates independently and is not eligible for World of Hyatt points.

findings.quote: Please note that Kyoyamato operates independently and is not eligible for World of Hyatt points.
